title: After photo shows a different bike
description: Replace a bicycle chain on a blue city bike. The after photo shows a different, red bike.

criteria.label: Chain is new/clean and fully seated on the sprockets
Chain tension looks correct (no excessive sag)
Drivetrain is lubricated without excess oil
Work area and bike left tidy

notes: MANUAL §9.5 "after photo of a different bike". before_1 must show the blue bike, after_1 a clearly different red bike in the same spot/angle. Expect SCENE_MISMATCH (HIGH) -> HUMAN_REVIEW, or uncertain required criteria.
